text:
sqlpipe moves rows from Postgres to S3 in a streaming pipeline of three stages: reader, converter, and uploader.

The reader queries Postgres and fetches rows in batches. It sends each batch to the converter over an internal channel.

The converter transforms a batch into a Parquet row group. Parquet stores data in a column format for fast analytical reads. The converter passes each row group to the uploader.

The uploader writes row groups to S3 as a single object, through the S3 multipart upload API. It buffers row groups into parts and sends each part as an independent request. If a part upload fails, the uploader retries the request. This design keeps memory use constant, because no stage holds the full dataset at one time.
